steps.label: 内容未改
steps.demo:
问候页 · 发布示例
构建输出 · UTF-8，无末尾换行message.f8a8cd8b.js
const message = "Hello!";
SHA-256 前 8 位：f8a8cd8b
页面中的脚本引用<script src="message.f8a8cd8b.js">↓
页面显示 · 已加载Hello!
自己运行完整示例

安装 Node.js 后，在项目终端粘贴整条命令，无需替换内容。

node --input-type=module -e 'import { createHash } from "node:crypto"; console.log(createHash("sha256").update("const message = \"Hello\";", "utf8").digest("hex"));'

应输出：

d3cc76611075d4a7af07ceae3f3aa1c2d90ba9e1499a7b9b9ff4884570e1c948

完整 SHA-256 摘要有 64 个十六进制字符，前 8 位与原始文件名一致。把 Hello 改为 Hello! 后再次运行，可核对变化。
steps.caption: 文件内容、编码和算法保持相同，摘要与文件名也相同；浏览器是否复用文件，还取决于缓存设置。

modules.title: 哈希还能用来判断什么

items.title: 相同与不同
items.text: 在算法、编码等条件相同时，相同内容得到相同摘要；摘要不同说明输入不同。摘要相同仍可能是碰撞，截短后更不能保证唯一。SHA-256 的完整十六进制摘要是 64 位；其他算法的长度可能不同。

items.title: 文件校验与 Git
items.text: 下载文件后，可用同一算法与可信渠道公布的摘要比较；如果文件和所谓的校验值一起被替换，比对相同也不能证明来源可信。Git 用哈希标识对象，提交的内容还包含父提交和提交信息等；短哈希需要在当前仓库中足以区分对象。

modules.title: 哪些结论不能直接推出
modules.text: 难以逆推是密码学哈希的设计目标，普通哈希不都具备这个性质。存密码应使用密码专用算法及盐；即使用了哈希，弱密码仍可能被猜出。文件名带哈希也不代替入口页面的更新与缓存设置。

lessonPractice.title: 脚本文件名已经随内容变化，但重新打开的网站仍显示旧文字；检查发现页面还引用旧文件。下一步先检查什么？

options.label: 检查入口页面是否更新，以及它的缓存是否仍返回旧引用
options.feedback: 决定性证据是页面还引用旧文件。先让入口引用新资源，再检查实际请求和显示结果。

options.label: 把新文件的哈希从 8 位加长到完整摘要，再发布一次
options.feedback: 当前证据是引用仍旧，不是文件名碰撞。增加摘要长度不会改变页面引用。

options.label: 取消脚本文件的缓存，让浏览器重新请求当前引用
options.feedback: 即使重新下载，当前引用仍指向旧脚本。应先检查入口页面与资源引用。

en.title: The script filename changed with its contents, but revisiting still shows old text. The page still references the old file. What should you inspect first?

options.label: Check whether the entry page and its cache still serve the old reference
options.feedback: The key evidence is the old reference. Update the entry to reference the new asset, then verify the request and displayed result.

options.label: Extend the new filename hash from 8 digits to the full digest and redeploy
options.feedback: The evidence points to an old reference, not a filename collision. A longer digest does not change that reference.

options.label: Disable caching for scripts so the browser fetches the referenced file again
options.feedback: Fetching the same old URL again still requests the old script. Inspect the entry page and its resource references first.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 网站发布后还是旧内容。请检查构建产物的内容哈希、入口页面的资源引用和缓存。改完后比较修改前后的文件名，再用内容不变的构建确认哈希稳定，并验证重新访问时加载了新文件。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The site still shows old content after deployment. Check content hashes in build output, resource references in the entry page, and caching. Compare filenames before and after the edit, rebuild unchanged content to check hash stability, and verify that revisiting loads the new file.

references.title: HTTP 缓存：资源 URL 与入口页面

learning.assumes: Know that files can change and a deployed site may still display old content.
learning.outcome: Recognize content hashes, distinguish updated files from updated page references, and ask AI to verify what actually loads.

modules.title: Why the page can stay old after the file changes

example.label: Content hash and page reference example

steps.label: Original file
steps.demo:
Greeting page · release example
Build output · UTF-8, no trailing newlinemessage.d3cc7661.js
const message = "Hello";
First 8 hex digits of SHA-256：d3cc7661
Script reference in the page<script src="message.d3cc7661.js">↓
Page output · LoadedHello
steps.caption: This example hashes the UTF-8 file contents with SHA-256 and uses only the first 8 hex digits in the filename. The page references this file and displays Hello.

Run the complete example

With Node.js installed, paste the entire command into your project terminal. No substitutions are needed.

node --input-type=module -e 'import { createHash } from "node:crypto"; console.log(createHash("sha256").update("const message = \"Hello\";", "utf8").digest("hex"));'

Expected output:

d3cc76611075d4a7af07ceae3f3aa1c2d90ba9e1499a7b9b9ff4884570e1c948

The full SHA-256 digest has 64 hex digits. Its first 8 digits match the original filename in the example. Change Hello to Hello! and run again to compare.
steps.caption: Identical contents, encoding, and algorithm produce the same digest and filename. Whether the browser reuses the file also depends on cache settings.

modules.title: What else can a hash help you check?

items.title: Matching and differing digests
items.text: With the same algorithm, encoding, and other conditions, identical contents yield identical digests. Different digests show different inputs. Matching digests can still be a collision, especially after truncation. A full SHA-256 hex digest has 64 digits; other algorithms can have different lengths.

items.title: Downloads and Git
items.text: Compare a download using the same algorithm against a digest from a trusted channel. If both file and comparison value are replaced, a match does not prove authenticity. Git hashes objects; commit contents also include parent commits and commit metadata. A short hash must distinguish the object within the current repository.

modules.title: What a hash does not guarantee
modules.text: Resistance to reversing is a design goal of cryptographic hashes; not every ordinary hash provides it. Passwords need a dedicated password-hashing algorithm and salt; weak passwords can still be guessed. Hashed filenames also need correct entry-page updates and cache settings.

distinctions.label: Encryption
distinctions.text: Encryption lets a key holder recover content. Hashing computes a digest without a corresponding decryption operation.

distinctions.label: Checksum
distinctions.text: A checksum is a value used to check data; not every checksum comes from a hash. SHA-256 can check files, but not all checksums are cryptographic hashes.
